profile.name: Instalco AB (publ)
profile.summary: Instalco AB (publ) provides planning and installation services in the electrical, heating and plumbing, ventilation, technical, consulting, and industrial areas in Sweden and rest of the Nordics. The company engages in energy storage and efficiency, construction, project planning, assembly, alarms and monitoring, data networks and control of technical equipment, energy optimization, charging ports for electric vehicles, remote reading, control technology, service and maintenance, and marine installations. It also provides heating and plumbing services, including installation of district heat, natural gas, heat pumps, and comfort cooling; pipe replacement and preventative maintenance; water treatment and water consumption optimization; sprinkler systems; new construction; ongoing repairs; conversions and extensions; project planning; control and regulation technology solutions; and energy efficiency measures services. In addition, the company offers ventilation services, such as installation and solutions for indoor climate, air treatment, and mandatory ventilation inspection; automation building; and control technology. Further, it engages in the provision of pipe and mechanical installation, cooling and electric power installation, infrastructure, automation, instrumentation, exhaust gas treatment, ballast water management, energy, safety, industrial scaffolding and weather protection, compressors, composite solutions, steel assembly, ground and mining services; and technical consulting services. The company serves construction companies, trusts, property owners, government agencies, municipalities and regions; housing, real estate, industrial, fishing, electricity and power, mining, shipping, maritime transportation, installation, energy, and industrial construction companies; and other industries. Instalco AB (publ) was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
profile.summary_fr: Instalco AB (publ) fournit des services de planification et d'installation dans les domaines de l'électricité, du chauffage et de la plomberie, de la ventilation, de la technique, du conseil et de l'industrie en Suède et dans le reste des pays nordiques. La société s'engage dans le stockage et l'efficacité énergétique, la construction, la planification de projets, l'assemblage, les alarmes et la surveillance, les réseaux de données et le contrôle des équipements techniques, l'optimisation de l'énergie, les ports de charge pour les véhicules électriques, la lecture à distance, la technologie de contrôle, le service et la maintenance, et les installations maritimes. Il fournit également des services de chauffage et de plomberie, y compris l'installation de chauffage urbain, de gaz naturel, de pompes à chaleur et de refroidissement de confort; remplacement de tuyaux et entretien préventif; traitement de l'eau et optimisation de la consommation d'eau; systèmes de gicleurs; nouvelle construction; réparations en cours; conversions et extensions; planification de projets; solutions technologiques de contrôle et de réglementation; et services de mesures d'efficacité énergétique.
